title: [CLAP] Cream Lemon - 08 [Uncensored][FF018EBA].mkv
description:
Another quality release from your friends at the Cream Lemon Archival Project!

It is our goal to preserve the original 1984 Cream Lemon series without interference from Japanese censorship. We are combining softsubbed translations from LamonAE, Japanese video sources, along with newly-uncovered and restored video sources from the United States and Brazil to create new softsubbed and uncensored MKV releases of as many of the original Cream Lemon episodes as we can get our hands on.

After 9 months of searching, we finally located the "Hellcats" tape, containing episode 8: Super Virgin, episode 14: Nalice Scramble, and episode 13: Ami III, completely uncensored. This release contains Super Virgin, the least popular Cream Lemon episode, fully uncensored. One shot had to be repeated due to damaged VHS footage, but the rest is fully intact. Enjoy!

Special thanks to Boris and rollei for all their hard work for this release!
